description: Spain Company Directory Scraper - Registro Mercantil. Scrape company data from Spain's official OpenData Registradores directory. Get NIF, officers, CNAE codes, legal form, address, and status from the Registro Mercantil - no API exists for this data. Advanced fields beyond this schema are also accepted (regdata_describe lists them).

cnaeCode.description: Filter results by CNAE economic activity code. Example: '6201' (computer programming), '4711' (retail sale in non-specialized stores)
cnaeCode.title: CNAE Activity Code

irusNumbers.description: List of IRUS numbers for direct company lookup. Skips search and goes straight to detail pages. Find IRUS in company URLs like /directorio/-/sociedad/{irus}/{company-name}. Example: '1000239977797'
irusNumbers.title: IRUS Numbers (Direct Lookup)

maxItems.description: Optional cap on billed dataset items returned.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of company records to return. Default: 100. Set higher for broader searches.
maxResults.title: Max Results

nifNumbers.description: List of NIF/CIF tax identification numbers to look up. Each NIF is looked up individually for exact-match results.
nifNumbers.title: NIF/CIF Numbers

province.description: Limit results to one Spanish province or one autonomous community (region). A province: its name in Spanish or the local language, common older spellings, or the INE code (1-52) - 'Madrid', 'Navarra', 'Bizkaia' or 'Vizcaya', 'A Coruña' or 'La Coruña', 'Illes Balears' or 'Baleares', '31'. A region: its Spanish, local or English name - 'Catalonia' or 'Cataluña', 'Andalucía', 'Basque Country' or 'Euskadi', 'Comunitat Valenciana', 'Galicia'. A region runs one search per province in it, one after another, and returns companies from all of them (pricing is unchanged: as listed in Pricing). A one-province region such as 'Comunidad de Madrid' is the same as that province. For A Coruña and Araba/Álava, combine the filter with a specific company name or activity code - on a very broad search the filter cannot be applied to those two provinces.
province.title: Province or region

searchQuery.description: Search by company name (partial match). Example: 'Telefonica', 'Inditex', 'Banco Santander'
searchQuery.title: Company Name

name: regdata_spain_company_directory
